label: Matter & Energy
scope_note: The physical universe at every scale — matter, energy, forces, space and time — from subatomic particles to the cosmos.

label: Physics
scope_note: The study of matter, energy, motion and force, and of the laws that relate them.

label: Classical mechanics
scope_note: Motion of bodies under forces at everyday scales and speeds: laws of motion, energy, momentum, oscillation.

label: Thermodynamics and statistical physics
scope_note: Heat, work, temperature and entropy, and how the collective behaviour of very many particles gives rise to them.

label: Electromagnetism
scope_note: Electric and magnetic fields, charges and currents, and light as an electromagnetic wave.

label: Optics
scope_note: The behaviour of light and other electromagnetic radiation and its interaction with matter.

label: Acoustics
scope_note: Sound and vibration: how they are produced, transmitted and perceived.

label: Fluid dynamics
scope_note: The flow of liquids and gases, from blood in vessels to winds and ocean currents.

label: Relativity
scope_note: Special and general relativity: space and time, motion at high speeds, and gravitation as the curvature of spacetime.

label: Quantum physics
scope_note: The behaviour of matter and energy at atomic and subatomic scales, where quantities come in discrete amounts and outcomes are probabilistic.

label: Particle physics
scope_note: Elementary particles and the fundamental interactions between them.

label: Nuclear physics
scope_note: Atomic nuclei: their structure, reactions and radioactivity, including fission and fusion.

label: Atomic and molecular physics
scope_note: The structure of atoms and molecules and their interactions with light and with each other.

label: Condensed matter physics
scope_note: Solids and liquids: properties such as conductivity, magnetism and superconductivity that arise from many interacting particles.

label: Plasma physics
scope_note: Ionized gases — the state of most visible matter in the universe — from stars and lightning to fusion reactors.

label: Chemistry
scope_note: The composition, structure and properties of substances and the reactions that transform them.

label: Chemical elements and the periodic table
scope_note: The known elements, their properties, and the periodic regularities that organize them.

label: Inorganic chemistry
scope_note: Compounds of all elements other than those centred on carbon chains: minerals, metals, salts, coordination compounds.

label: Organic chemistry
scope_note: Carbon-based compounds, their structure, reactions and synthesis.

label: Physical chemistry
scope_note: The physical principles behind chemical systems: energy, rates and equilibrium of reactions, molecular structure.

label: Analytical chemistry
scope_note: Methods for identifying substances and measuring how much of each is present.

label: Biochemistry
scope_note: The chemistry of living things: proteins, nucleic acids, metabolism and the reactions that sustain life.

label: Polymer chemistry
scope_note: Large molecules built from repeating units, natural and synthetic: plastics, rubber, fibres, proteins.

label: Electrochemistry
scope_note: Chemical reactions that produce or consume electric current: batteries, electrolysis, corrosion.

label: Astronomy and space science
scope_note: Celestial objects, space and the physical universe beyond Earth.

label: The Solar System
scope_note: The Sun and the planets, moons, asteroids, comets and dust bound to it.

label: Planetary science
scope_note: The formation, composition and evolution of planets and moons, including Earth seen as one planet among others.

label: Stars and stellar astrophysics
scope_note: How stars form, shine, evolve and die, and the remnants they leave.

label: Galaxies
scope_note: Galaxies and galaxy clusters: their structure, formation and distribution.

label: Cosmology
scope_note: The origin, evolution and large-scale structure of the universe as a whole.

label: Astrophysics
scope_note: Physics applied to astronomical objects and phenomena.

label: Astrobiology
scope_note: The origin, evolution and distribution of life in the universe, and the search for life beyond Earth.

label: Observational astronomy
scope_note: Observing the sky across the electromagnetic spectrum and beyond, and the instruments used to do it.

label: Cultural astronomy
scope_note: How different cultures, past and present, have observed, named and used the sky: calendars, navigation, sky lore.

label: Measurement and metrology
scope_note: The science of measurement: standards, instruments, uncertainty and the definition of units.

label: Units of measurement
scope_note: Systems of units, including the International System (SI) and the many traditional systems used around the world.
